newsitem.title: CANADA: Breakwater to buy Bougrine zinc/lead mine.
newsitem.headline: Breakwater to buy Bougrine zinc/lead mine.

text.p: Breakwater Resources Ltd said on Monday it signed an agreement to purchase all of the assets of Societe Miniere de Bougrine for US$19.3 million.
The deal includes the Bougrine zinc/lead mine in Tunisia, an 1150-tonne per day concentrator and related infrastructure.

Breakwater said the Bougrine mine has total reserves of 4.0 million tonnes grading 10.8 percent zinc and 2.2 percent lead and proven and probable mineable reserves of 2.8 million tonnes averaging 12.2 percent zinc and 2.4 percent lead.
The reserves are sufficient for seven years of operation at a planned production rate of 400,000 tonnes per annum.

The Bougrine mine, constructed at a cost of US$80 million, began production in June 1994, Breakwater said. It said operations were suspended in October 1996 due to low zinc prices and financial constraints.
Breakwater said it plans to upgrade the underground mine at an estimated cost of US$7 million in order to ensure a consistent production rate of 400,000 tonnes of ore per yer.
Production is expected to begin in early 1998.
